name: Nexus Certificate Maanager AnyCA REST Gateway Plugin
description: Nexus Certificate Manager plugin for the AnyCA REST Gateway framework

ca_plugin_config.name: Host
ca_plugin_config.description: The path to the Nexus CM server, including port

ca_plugin_config.name: AuthCertificatePath
ca_plugin_config.description: The path to the PFX certificate for authenticating into Nexus CM

ca_plugin_config.name: AuthCertPassword
ca_plugin_config.description: The password for the authentication certificate

ca_plugin_config.name: Enabled
ca_plugin_config.description: Flag to Enable or Disable gateway functionality. Disabling is primarily used to allow creation of the CA prior to configuration information being available.
